title: Evaluation of the pair layout
statement: For any natural numbers $n$ and $a$, and any Boolean-valued functions $x$ on the first $n$ indices and $y$ on the first $a$ indices, evaluating the pair layout on the concatenation of these two finite bit strings gives the self-delimiting encoding of those strings: the resulting bit string is $\langle x,y\rangle$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ assigns a Boolean to each index below $n$
$y$ assigns a Boolean to each index below $a$
